# Gradle wrapper bootstrap

`gradle-wrapper.jar` is the Apache-2.0 Gradle wrapper bootstrap bundled with the
locally installed JetBrains PyCharm distribution. Its SHA-256 is
`16caeaf66d57a0d1d2087fef6a97efa62de8da69afa5b908f40db35afc4342da`.

The wrapper downloads the pinned Gradle 8.13 binary distribution from
`services.gradle.org`. It contains no project secrets or machine-specific
configuration.
